children: The Dalmia Bharat MD and CEO reflected on infrastructure, heritage and India’s growing global stature in his message
Birthday wishes to Shri Narendra Modiji
A building is made of cement but a nation is built on vision and mission. A nation truly comes into its own when its 1.4 billion people believe that together, they can achieve the extraordinary.
Over the past decade, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji has given India precisely this very belief.

I have seen how the infrastructure-led development has transformed India's growth story. The unprecedented expansion and modernisation of our national highways, metro systems, airports, railways and ports has created a powerful multiplier effect on the economy, generating employment and opportunity for millions across the country.
Equally inspiring is another dimension of his vision — development alongside heritage - brilliantly summarised as ‘Vikas bhi, Virsat bhi’.
Even as India has modernised, Prime Minister Modi ji has given the nation's civilisation, culture and heritage a renewed identity and standing on the world stage.

Today, India's stature extends well beyond our own borders. The recent BRICS Summit stood as a powerful symbol of India's growing leadership in global affairs — a reflection of a nation that is respected, heard and sought after.
Prime Minister Modi ji, on your birthday, on behalf of the Dalmia Bharat family, I extend my warmest wishes to you.
You have set an inspiring resolve — Viksit Bharat 2047. The Dalmia Bharat family will continue to make its fullest contribution towards this vision, as we always have.
I wish you good health, continued strength and every happiness in the years ahead.
